name: terms-changes
title: Terms Changes
description: Terms re-acceptance with a summary and exact word diff since the accepted version, changed numbers called out, Accept locked until every change has stayed on screen long enough to read (an early tap jumps to the next unread one), and a consent record with both versions.

meta.summary: Shows what changed in updated terms since the version a user accepted, and keeps Accept locked until each change has been on screen.
meta.server: Record consent server-side with the version ids and timestamp, and check the accepted version on later requests.
catches: Every change since the accepted version, as a word diff
Changed numbers (fees, days, limits), called out
Changes not yet on screen for the dwell time
An early Accept tap, which jumps to the next unread change
Consent record with both versions, timestamp and changes seen
limits: "Seen" means on screen for dwell ms, not read or understood
Not legal advice on what counts as valid consent in your jurisdiction
Store the consent record server-side yourself
a11y: Changes region is focusable (tabIndex=0) with an aria-label
Removed/added text has sr-only prefixes; read changes marked with an aria-labelled check
Progress in a polite live region; Accept uses aria-disabled and is described by what's left
